summary: The tooling is solid. content-lint passes (977 strings, 0 errors), typecheck is clean, and the gallery has 0 overflow across 756 checks; I looked at every section. In-game text is wired in: taunt bubbles, loading tip + 宜/忌 calendar, results victory line + grade quote + achievement chips, credits, how-to and garage. The achievement system holds up where the brief worried most: quit and restart mid-race and mid-police-chase unlocked nothing, early throttle is correctly not a perfect start, and saves have no duplicates. But two rules break on real gameplay. A real Big Gulp can never earn 吃了吗您, and the corgi letting a calm player go falsely awards 腿短不是借口. The unit's own scenarios hide both: one injects a status real combat never has at that moment, the other asserts the legacy behaviour. As a meme critic: capybara, cat, seagull, the credits and parts of the calendar are genuinely funny, kind and natural. Elsewhere the copy leans on a handful of recycled gags (鹅 in 45 of 687 strings, pigeon 21/35 lines about being late, penguin 12/35 about 冷静/冰/优雅) and mostly 2016-2021 memes. It is full of near-duplicates the lint cannot see, including the same sign joke two or three times on one track, plus flat filler and a dozen awkward lines. A competent first draft, not a commercial writer's pass.

issues.title: 吃了吗您 (gulp) can never unlock from a real gulp
issues.detail: Scripted race with no stubs (shots/review/content/r1-meme/ach-real.mjs): a real Big Gulp on the cat (scale 0.85) logged skill:cast pelican.gulp @3.17 s, then skill:hit pelican.gulp victim=cat @3.97 s (the spit), then skill:end @4.42 s. 'gulp' never unlocked. rules-combat.ts onPlayerSkillHit counts a swallow only if the victim still has status 'gulped' at skill:hit. But combat/skills/gulp.ts spit() calls removeStatus('gulped') before skillHit, and applyHit ignores gulped riders anyway (combat/ctx.ts targetable), so that state can never be observed. tools/content-ach.mjs 'gulp-torpedo-wing' passes only because it pushes a fake 'gulped' status before emitting skill:hit.
issues.fix: Tell swallow from bite the way gulp.ts does: a pelican.gulp skill:hit on a rider whose ROSTER[character].scale <= 0.85 is a swallow (only bigger riders get bitten). Rewrite the scenario to follow the real order (status already gone at skill:hit) and add a real gulp to tools/content-game.mjs.

issues.title: 腿短不是借口 (corgi) unlocks when the corgi simply lets a calm player go
issues.detail: ach-police.mjs case A (no stubs, police=1): the chase spawned with reason 'spawn' @3.67 s, and I rode beside the corgi with heat < 0.12. @23.67 s race/police.ts giveUp(false) emitted police:alert {level:0} with no reason. That code path is commented 'a model citizen alongside: the corgi lets it go (no lost credit)'. 'corgi' (甩掉柯基警官) unlocked anyway. rules-ride.ts keeps the legacy branch `reason === undefined ? player.mode === 'racing' : reason === 'lost'`, and tools/content-ach.mjs scenario 'police' case (a) asserts that a reasonless 0 is an escape. The race unit now always sends 'lost' for real escapes. Quit and restart mid-chase (cases B and C) were clean: the teardown's reasonless alert arrives after attach(null).
issues.fix: Count only reason === 'lost'. At minimum, once a chase started with reason 'spawn', require 'lost'. Flip scenario (a) to expect no unlock.

issues.title: The same jokes over and over: near-duplicates the lint cannot see
issues.detail: content-lint only catches exact or punctuation-blind duplicates (my counter: shots/review/content/r1-meme/repeat.mjs). Inside one voice: pigeon 「准时到达，就这一次。」/「这次，我没迟到！」, 「这次没鸽，意外吧？」/「咕咕！意不意外？」, 「鸽了你。」/「咕咕，你被鸽了。」; shiba 「汪！（墨镜反光）」/「汪！（推墨镜）」/「汪！（墨镜闪光）」; penguin 「冰面太少，差评。」/「这路面，滑度不够。」/「这地，不够滑……」/「没冰，发挥不出来。」; corgi 「依法执行，请配合。」/「请配合执法。」; seagull 「冠军？也是我的。」/「第一名也是 MINE！」. Across the cast: 让一让 x3, 会回来 x4, 热身 x3 (goose/penguin/sloth defeat lines), 为我骄傲 x2, 「X，启动！」 x2, 这叫专业 x3, 从不迟到 in both the sloth's and the corgi's victory lines, 「我只是…」 x6. On one track: mountain shows 弯弯有大鹅 three times (track blurb, TRACK_BILLBOARDS.mountain[0], ROAD_SIGNS[5]) and 其实是落鱼 twice (billboard + TRACK_SIGNS); city has 「雨天路滑 大鹅更凶」 + 「雨天 鹅更滑」; 「夜间限速：看心情」 repeats 「限速：随缘」. Across files: a tip vs CREDIT_OUTRO (没有任何真实鹈鹕受到伤害), a tip vs the shared-bike blurb (押金), a tip vs the fixie blurb (刹车). Announcer alts reuse achievement names (一鱼两吃, 一条龙服务, 咸鱼翻身, 稳如老狗, 就差亿点点) and the pelican taunt 一嘴入魂. With about one bubble per 8 s and random tips, players hit repeats within a single race.
issues.fix: Add a near-duplicate check to tools/content-lint.mjs: strip ……/punctuation, then flag any shared run of 4+ characters plus short templates (为我骄傲, 热身, 启动). Check within a character, across characters, and across one track's billboard + sign + calendar + blurb pool. Rewrite every hit with a different joke engine.

issues.title: Memes are dated and several characters are one-note
issues.detail: Nearly every meme is from 2016-2021: 了解一下, 我全都要, 飘了, 稳如老狗, 亿点点 (x3), C 位出道, 永远的神, 全村的…, 还有谁, 超神, 落地成盒, 秋名山 (x2). The only recent memes are the SPEC's own (哈基米, OIIA, 那咋了). 鹅 appears in 45 of 687 strings, including 6 of 43 billboards and 6 of 32 lines in each of the city and mountain pools. Pigeon has 21/35 lines about being late, penguin 12/35 about 冷静/冰/优雅, pelican 13/35 about 嘴. Capybara, cat and seagull are genuinely good; the others read like a first draft. Obvious angles are missing: the pigeon is literally a racing pigeon (赛鸽/信鸽) in a racing game.
issues.fix: Per racer, replace the 3-4 weakest taunts with current, kind riffs that fit the voice and the skill (<= 12 字). Examples: goose 「硬控你！HONK！」 (honk = stun), pigeon 「赛鸽血统，懂？」 / 「已读，下次回。」, penguin 「班味？我只有冰味。」, seagull 「主打一个顺手。」, corgi 「情绪价值给到，罚单照开。」, pelican 「泼天的鱼，轮到我了！」, capybara 「松弛感，懂吗？」. Cap any single gag (鹅 / 鸽 / 咸鱼 / 嘴) at about 1 in 10 lines per pool.

issues.title: Flat lines with no joke, including the first bike every player sees
issues.detail: The garage opens on 风之翼 公路车 with 「碳纤维车架，鹈鹕友好型弯把。」 (scr-garage.png), which is a spec sheet line; the mtb's 「避震拉满，草地如履平地。」 is the same. WRECK_LINES are mostly literal: 「撞车了……」「被打下车了……」「被揍趴下了……」「中招翻车……」「被技能送走了……」「路障赢了……」. Also filler: skill shouts 「咸鱼鱼雷，发射！」「翅膀张开，起飞！」「交出来吧你！」「全速前进！！」; taunts 「低调地超个车。」「优雅，永不过时。」「前方车辆，请减速！」「超速了啊，朋友！」「让本喵先过。」; place alts 「不上不下，刚刚好。」「中游选手，稳住。」; calendar 带伞/淋雨, 登高/恐高, 发光/发呆. These sit next to strong lines like 甩尾/甩锅 and 墙：你礼貌吗？
issues.fix: Give each line a twist or cut it. Examples: roadbike 「轻到海风一吹就跑，所以骑快点。」, wreck.traffic 「汽车：我也没想到……」, wreck.skill 「技能说明，没骗人……」, calendar 带伞 / 当落汤鹈, penguin 「西装革履，顺路超车。」.

issues.title: Awkward or wrong Chinese and logic slips
issues.detail: corgi 「别跑！我腿短我不怕！」 is a non sequitur. Goose skill 「都给我哆嗦！」 is an unnatural imperative. POLICE chase 「跑得了鹈鹕，跑不了庙！」 garbles 跑了和尚跑不了庙 (the 庙 means nothing here). Goose 「你瞅啥？再瞅一个？」 clips the meme. Tip 「按 B 打铃…大鹅不吃这一套，它会直接冲过来。」 contradicts itself: 不吃这一套 means it ignores the taunt. Tip 「鸽子会突然消失…这就叫放鸽子。」 misuses 放鸽子 (to stand someone up). The oil tip ends on a non sequitur, 「别贪近道。」. Pelican tagline 「都归我的嘴」 is unidiomatic. Also 「OIIA OIIA！赢喵！」, and grade A 「离神只差一条咸鱼。」 has no clear meaning. Achievement descs 「一次连续击倒两/三名对手」 contradict themselves (the rule is a 3 s window). The tip 「薯条大盗从未落网，因为柯基警官的腿太短了。」 mocks the corgi's legs from outside, while the brief allows only the corgi's own self-awareness.
issues.fix: Suggested rewrites: 「别跑！腿短，但我执着！」, 「全体，原地哆嗦！」, 「跑了鹈鹕，跑不了鹈鹕湾！」, 「你瞅啥？再瞅一个试试？」, 「…大鹅最吃这一套：它会直接冲过来。」, 「鸽子会突然消失。说好一起骑，人呢？这就叫放鸽子。」, 「这条路上的鱼，都归我这张嘴。」, 「OIIA OIIA！赢了喵！」, 「3 秒内连续击倒两名对手」. Have the corgi say the 薯条大盗 line about itself.

issues.title: 'Not X but Y' AI-tic constructions and inconsistent doge punctuation
issues.detail: The brief bans 不是…而是-style tics, yet penguin 「我只是滑倒了，不是输了。」, tip 「腿短不是缺点，是为了降低风阻。」 and tip 「它说那不叫偷懒，叫“借力”。」 use exactly that template. Shiba ends half its Chinese with an ASCII '.' ('so 快.', 'so 卷. very 累.', 'many 对手. no 威胁.', 'very 第一. much 骄傲.') and half with '。' ('wow. 你好慢。', 'amaze. 你追不上。', 'bye bye. 汪。', 'not wow. 一点也不。').
issues.fix: Make them straight punchlines: 「摔也要摔出南极范儿。」, 「柯基警官说：腿短，风阻小。」, 「滑总从来不蹬车，全靠“借力”。」. Use ASCII periods on all doge lines; none of the 。 lines has a voice clip.

issues.title: Hurt lines play after any wreck, so one blames the wrong rider
issues.detail: race/ai/taunts.ts shows hurtLines on every rival rider:respawn, whatever the cause: wall, water, traffic, or a KO by another rival. So the goose's 「偷袭！卑鄙的鹈鹕！」 can pop up after it rides into the sea or the cat knocks it out.
issues.fix: Keep hurtLines cause-neutral, e.g. 「谁？！谁偷袭鹅？！」. Alternatively add a koByPlayer set and file a race request to pick lines by crash cause and attacker.

issues.title: 蹭饭达人 unlocks by accident in the first seconds
issues.detail: 'slingshot' unlocks on the first rider:boost of kind 'draft', and pulling out of the pack off the grid already triggers one. It unlocked in all three of my races within about 1-5 s without any steering: ach-real.mjs, ach-police A, and race-bubbles.png, which shows SLINGSHOT! at 0:01.23. An achievement nobody notices earning is no reward.
issues.fix: Require something deliberate: 3 slingshots in one race, or a slingshot followed by an overtake (race:placeChange to a better place) within 2 s.

issues.title: cross-unit: 33 written lines never reach the player
issues.detail: The pelican's 12 taunts, 6 KO, 6 hurt and 3 per-skill shouts (「咸鱼鱼雷，发射！」/「张嘴！全吞了！」/「翅膀张开，起飞！」) are never shown or voiced: race/ai/taunts.ts and audio/events-combat.ts skip the player, so the 5 pelican voice clips never play. POLICE_LINES.chase (6 lines) is unused too, because race/police.ts toasts only alert, busted and lost. status/content.md files no request for any of this.
issues.fix: File requests: ui-hud shows a small player bubble on KO, skill cast and respawn (pelican koLines / skillLines / hurtLines); audio barks the player's voiced lines; race toasts a POLICE_LINES.chase line at alert level 2. Otherwise cut the dead lines.

issues.title: cross-unit: credits row wraps 'bicycle' onto its own line; the gallery missed it
issues.detail: On the real credits screen (scr-credits.png), 「提示词 — Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle」 wraps and leaves 'bicycle' alone on line 2. The gallery's credits check still passed it, because its box does not match ui-screens' credits column.
issues.fix: Mirror the real credits column width in sandbox/content.ts. Then either split the prompt into two balanced lines in data or ask ui-screens for text-wrap: balance / a smaller Latin size on that row.
